1. **[blocking][issue-impact] Missing projection targets are silently defaulted, rather than rejected.** `ProjectionConfig.target` is optional and `target()` substitutes `.jit/<name>.md`, so a declared projection without `target` renders successfully instead of producing the required typed nonzero error. This fails REQ-07. `crates/jit/src/config.rs:981-1018`.

2. **[blocking][issue-impact] Rendering all projections can leave earlier targets modified after a later projection fails.** `project_render(None)` renders and writes each projection inside one loop. A valid alphabetically earlier projection is persisted before a later unknown kind, missing source, or bad region marker returns an error, contradicting REQ-07’s “nothing is partially written” contract and the command documentation. `crates/jit/src/commands/project.rs:102-121`.
